column1: # ─── Queue format reference (this file is never processed) ────────────────
# Copy/edit topics.queue.tsv to add new work. The scheduled workflow drains
# topics.queue.tsv, not this file.
# Each non-comment, non-blank line is one job:
#     <topic>           TAB    <section>           TAB    <intent>
# The <intent> field is optional — leave it blank and the pipeline
# classifies from the topic phrasing ("How to" → tutorial, "X vs Y" →
# comparison, "CVE-XXXX" → news, etc.).
# Examples below (with explicit tabs shown as 4 spaces for readability;
# in the real queue file, use real TAB characters):
# How to Detect Lateral Movement in Active Directory    network-security    tutorial
# Burp Suite vs OWASP ZAP in 2026                       tools               comparison
# CVE-2026-XXXXX in Apache Tomcat: Detection Playbook   news                news
# LockBit 5 Affiliate Playbook                          malware-analysis    analysis
# Fix Kerberos KRB_AP_ERR_MODIFIED Errors               tutorials           troubleshooting
# Sigma Rule Cheat Sheet                                tutorials           guide
# Curation tips:
# - Keep topics specific. "Active Directory Security" is too broad; "Detect
#   Kerberoasting with Sysmon Event 10" is tight.
# - Pair complementary topics in sequence so the cron output reads like a
#   curriculum, not a topic dump.
# - Pre-write 4-8 weeks of topics at a time. Two minutes of thinking on
#   Sunday saves you scrambling Monday morning.
